existing_group_assignments.rationale: Inhibition of fatty acid oxidation is the same endpoint as decreased fatty acid beta-oxidation, so it fits this group, which already pairs the increase and decrease directions.
Pulmonary inflammation is the same process (inflammation) as the group's other events, set in a lung-specific context.
Activation of the inflammation pathway is a general increased-inflammation event and fits the group's mix of general and context-specific events.

new_groups.rationale: Both concern the folate transporter, one as an affected transporter and the other as decreased folate uptake, which are distinct processes.
